_about: AUTHORED by the game team from the AD-RT policy names and descriptions (policies.json, policy_type_id 2). Not an ARGUS document. Keys are 'pilot:rule' because rule names are reused with different meanings across pilots. 'detect_with' is a list of groups: the player's network detects the alarm if, for EVERY group, it has at least one card from that group. 'plausible' [low, high] (optional) excludes alarm values outside that range for this rule, on top of the per-quantity ranges in the build script. Units are NOT given in the ARGUS alarm data; 'unit' is our assumption unless 'unit_confirmed' is true. Entries with needs_review=true are uncertain.

dl_features._about: AI (deep-learning) alarms have no rule. The build takes the alarm's top feature (largest share in top_feature_contributions); if its share is at least 30% and its name matches a pattern here, the alarm is treated as the pseudo-rule named, which must be in 'rules' for that pilot. Its 'measures' text starts with a preposition ('in the ...'), because the game shows it as 'the AI noticed something unusual in the ...'. Wind-direction features are deliberately not mapped: they are not linked to any danger.
